title: SASSA Provincial Guide
description: SASSA services and contact details for each province in South Africa.

seo.metaDescription: Find SASSA offices, payment collection points, and local contacts in every South African province: Gauteng, Western Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, and more.

contentBlocks.text: SASSA operates through regional offices in each of South Africa's nine provinces. Find the office nearest you, learn about local payment collection, and get province-specific guidance.
